avoid: Playful rounded/bubbly style with saturated primary colors
why: Undermines the trust and seriousness financial products need to convey
Feels alarming/unpolished in a context where users are often anxious
Signals a lack of seriousness for high-stakes professional decisions

avoid: Large whitespace-heavy minimalism with sparse cards
why: Wastes screen space power users need for scanning dense data

avoid: Multi-step animated transitions on the checkout flow
why: Adds friction and perceived slowness right when users want to complete a purchase

avoid: Small touch targets and low-contrast pastel-on-pastel text
why: Children and low-vision users can't reliably interact with tiny, low-contrast controls

avoid: Emoji used as functional icons in the product UI
why: Reads as unprofessional and inconsistent across platforms/fonts

avoid: Default system fonts (Arial/system-ui) for display headlines
why: Fails to convey the premium positioning the brand is paying for
Fails to create the energy/excitement gaming audiences expect

avoid: Templated hero-centric SaaS pattern with generic gradient blob
why: Makes a personal portfolio indistinguishable from a generic SaaS landing page
